native_context: Electron renderer-to-main IPC and native capabilities
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: Electron renderer-to-main IPC and native capabilities — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Open BrowserWindow settings, preload/contextBridge exposure, IPC registration and main-process handlers. Record sender/frame/origin and which navigations can supply renderer content.
controls.controlled_verification: Using an owned local renderer, invoke one inert privileged operation from the intended UI and an untrusted frame/context. Trace argument/resource authority at the main-process consumer; a narrowly exposed bridge may still delegate excessive power.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: contextIsolation or disabled nodeIntegration alone is not proof that IPC is authorized. A handler name in preload is inventory until an untrusted sender can reach a protected effect.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Expose minimal typed operations and validate sender/context plus resource/action authority at consumption. Retest intended app UI, untrusted frame and originally evidenced navigation path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
